name: Content Reminders and Notifications
description: Provides editors and administrators with a system for notifying or reminding content authors about their content.
project_description: Content Reminders and Notifications lets editors and administrators schedule email reminders about specific nodes. It defines a 'content_reminder' config entity holding a node id, one or more comma-separated recipient emails, a send date/time and an optional message. A reminder can be created either from a standalone admin UI at /admin/structure/content_reminder or inline via a 'Content Reminder' fieldset that the module injects (through hook_form_alter) into the edit form of any node whose content type is enabled on the settings form. On each cron run the module loads enabled reminders whose date/time has passed, emails the configured recipients a link to the node plus the message, then disables the reminder. It requires no modules outside core (it uses core node and the mail system) and provides a single 'administer content reminder' permission.
